general_information.name: I’M NOT SURE IF YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY PAPERS? I GO BY MAI FANG. IF YOU NEED THE EXACT LEGAL FORM, I THINK YOU MAY NEED TO ASK ME AGAIN.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I’ve been feeling very tired, my back has been bothering me, and I haven’t been sleeping well. I also feel like a burden to my family.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to sleep better and have more energy, maybe feel more able to help my family.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Clonazepam.; Dose: 0.5 mg at night, I think.; Start Or Duration: About 6 months ago, maybe.; Side Effects: It makes me sleepy in the morning.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes, I’m also taking hydrocodone-acetaminophen.; Dose: One tablet, 5/325 mg, up to twice a day as needed.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2024.; Side Effects: It tends to cause constipation.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes — acetaminophen.; Dose: 500 mg as needed, usually once a day.; Start Or Duration: I don’t know when I started that one.; Side Effects: None that I know of.

medical_history.medical_conditions: Just the chronic lower back pain, as far as I know.
medical_history.surgical_history: Surgery: Gallbladder removal.; Date: In 2015, I think.; Details: No, nothing else.

medication_allergies.medication_allergies: Allergy 1: Name Or Description: Codeine.; Reaction: I got a rash and my face swelled up.; Date Or Age: I don’t know.

education_employment_legal_history.highest_education: I never had formal schooling, so I’m not really able to read well.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Laos, and then I was in a refugee camp. That’s mostly what I remember from early on.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I was still in the refugee camp and then later resettled. That’s about all I can say.
personal_history.significant_relationships: My husband died about a year ago — he had a heart attack.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to support my family and get my energy back.
